description: This source file defines the CLIInstaller enum in Swift, responsible for managing the installation, detection, and status checking of the openclaw CLI tool within a macOS environment. It includes methods for locating the installed executable, performing installation via a shell script, and parsing installation events.

methods.name: installedLocation
methods.description: Returns the file path of the installed openclaw executable if present.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if openclaw is installed by verifying the existence of the executable.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation of the openclaw CLI asynchronously, providing status updates via a callback.
